properties.description: Synthetic engineering reference; native validation required before enablement.
properties.query:
let Evaluation = now();
let E = tolong((Evaluation - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1s);
let Rows = materialize(
    DetectionEvents_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= Evaluation - 30m
    | where TimeGenerated < Evaluation
    | where quality == "valid" and schema_version == 1
    | where event_time >= E - 1800 and event_time < E
    | where ingest_time <= E
    | summarize Hashes=make_set(payload_hash, 2),
        arg_min(ingest_time, *) by tenant, source, event_id
    | where array_length(Hashes) == 1
    | extend EventRef=strcat(tenant, "|", source, "|", event_id)
);
Rows
| where source == "identity" and action == "auth_denied"
| where outcome == "failure"
| extend bucket_start=tolong(floor(event_time / 300.0)) * 300
| where bucket_start + 300 <= E
| summarize Count=count(), first_event_time=min(event_time),
    last_event_time=max(event_time), event_refs=make_set(EventRef)
    by tenant, principal, bucket_start
| where Count >= 3
| extend event_refs=array_sort_asc(event_refs)
| extend signal_key=strcat("DET-002|", tenant, "|", principal,
    "|", tostring(bucket_start))

| extend detection_id="DET-002", version="1.0.0",
    mode="complete", severity="medium",
    confidence="observed-contract-match"
| extend TimeGenerated=unixtime_seconds_todatetime(last_event_time)
| project TimeGenerated, detection_id, version, signal_key,
    tenant, principal, first_event_time, last_event_time,
    event_refs, mode, severity, confidence, count=Count, bucket_start
